candidates.summary: check_for_collision_with_friends: a mover the prefilter passes over (X >= 2) goes back to a DEX put just before the loop head (search_for_target's own pattern) instead of through consider_next_mover_2abe's DEX and an always-taken BPL, so each rejection costs 3 cycles less; the entry INX (the LDX #&0B above the window is not mine to change) makes the first DEX land on &0B. +2 bytes, so it assembles in every build (the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW twin has 4 bytes free, 2 left).
candidates.equivalence: Only entry: JSR check_for_collision_with_friends (one caller, grenade code ~4947); check_for_collision_with_non_bullet_movers_loop (the label above the window, kept) is referenced nowhere but the BPL this replaces, and friends_in_full / consider_next_mover_2abe / leave_2ac2 nowhere outside the window (grep src/). Entry: LDX #&0B, INX gives X=&0C, the DEX makes it &0B, the CPX #&02 sets N/Z/C before anything reads them, so the first mover is tested exactly as before; A, Y untouched. Rejections: both BCCs are reached only past the CPX #&02 / BCC (X >= 2), so after the DEX X >= 1 and falls into CPX with the same X, Y, and the same live A (the SBC result is dead, the left test reloads A), as the old DEX / BPL (always taken there) / CPX; DEX and BPL's flags are overwritten by the CPX. The low movers X=1,0 are still full-checked by the CPX #&02 / BCC friends_in_full (flags there are CPX's, as before: C=0, N=1). The full-check path is untouched: JSR check_for_mover_collision_with_mover_X, BCC, JSR check_if_friendly, BCC leave_2ac2, then the unchanged DEX / BPL fr1_head / SEC / RTS: exits are C=0 with X = the hostile mover (Y = mover_to_update from check_if_friendly), or C=1, X=&FF, N=1, Z=0 after the last mover (X=0). The prefilter's two tests, their operands and order are unchanged; nothing is written, the stack and interrupts see nothing. V (the only flag not set the same on the low-mover path: the old loop's last SBC may or may not have run) is read by no logic code (BVC/BVS/CLV only in render.6502, sky_off.6502, scroll_hazel.6502, each setting it itself).
candidates.relies_on: Measured on 2026-10-22 by building HEAD and this change (bench = DEBUG_LIVES) in a scratch copy and running tools/pcprof.mjs as the gate does: work a pass 34422.4 -> 34413.1 (seed 1, -9.3) and 39622.9 -> 39610.6 (RIGHT, -12.3); the hot path is a rejected mover (hist of the loop head over the same runs: 3.6 a pass seed 1, 5.0 holding RIGHT, ~0.2 a pass reach the full check), 3 cycles each, less the entry INX 2 cycles x 0.37-0.53 calls a pass. Page crossings (listing diff, instruction by instruction, with pc-seed1/pc-right weights): the new loop is in page &27 (&2781-&27AF), all its branches in page; everything from &27AE to the slack before &3400 slides up 2 bytes (unused_3400_original's SKIP 193 -> 191; the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW build 4 -> 2 bytes free, 'bench', 'full', 'ship', 'release', SKY_HELI=0 and the GAMEPLAY_* build all assemble). The only branches whose page crossing changes go from crossing to not: BPL calculate_bullet_screen_address (&28FC) and BCS not_throwing_grenade (&2CFC), both 0 cycles a pass in the profiles. Indexed operands whose base moves by 2 (keys,Y &2A75 -> &2A77 [8 entries, ASSERTed in one page], sfx_request,X, enemy_helicopters_maximum_x_low,X, movers_flags/minimum/maximum_x_low - 1,X/Y, mover_type_scoring(_tens)_table,Y, game_over_text + 20,X/Y, offsets_to_numbers_table,X, sky_h/ojl/ojh/adr_hi/adr_lo/on/k,X/Y at &3169-&3177) are all small tables nowhere near a page end after the move (checked: none crosses). compiled_call's STA romsel operand and RTS and sky_room (&3001 -> &3003) slide across &3000: the SMC operands compiled_vec/compiled_back stay at &2FF9/&2FFC (below &3000), and shadow &3000-&3FFF is a copy of main's taken at game start (decision 23), so a constant byte there reads the same on both sides. Checked in the emulator on the bench build vs HEAD's: tools/passlock.mjs seed 1 (3000 passes) and seed 3 (4000) with --screen --unclobber: state and every shown screen identical; the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW twin of this change vs this change, seed 5, 4000 passes --screen: identical; tools/helilock.mjs flight 5: no frame differing.
